165:t_10:20.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
(Idiot... Right to the end, you never knew how I felt...)

165:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Please, cry as much as you need to, $$ミヒロ$$. Until you've had your fill, I won't let anyone through here.)

165:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Today there will be no congratulations for the ace pilot, either. Even I can't muster the mood for that...)

165:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(...There's no use thinking about it. Humans and robots alike can only give their all to what's in front of them.)

165:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(For me, that means collecting $$Ｚチップ$$... So whatever happens, I will open the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ for business.)

166:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So $$ネオ・ジオン$$ had detected our movements as well.」

166:t_000:2.en:
$$メラン$$
「All we can do is hold out here until the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ arrives.」

166:t_000:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「It'll be fine. We've got the Colonel on our side.」

166:t_000:4.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Hey, hey, $$クェス$$. Me, of the $$トライスター$$, $$ロンド・ベル$$'s elite, and...」

166:t_000:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「It would be a problem if you forgot about me, from $$エコーズ$$.」

166:t_000:6.en:
$$クェス$$
「I trust Captain $$ナイジェル$$ and the others too. The problem is...」

166:t_000:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$... I can't laugh the way I used to anymore.」

166:t_000:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「...I still haven't sorted it out inside myself. So I can't tell you anything.」

166:t_000:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「But I'll say this much. I'm fighting for what I believe in.」

166:t_000:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「And I will beat you, I swear. Fair and square.」

166:t_000:15.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Looks like you've shaken it off a little.」

166:t_000:16.en:
$$ブライト$$
(That's right, Ensign $$リディ$$. You're still young...)

166:t_000:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
(See with your own eyes, hear with your own ears, and act on your own judgment. For your own sake.)

166:t_000:18.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Are you up to this, $$バナージ$$?」

166:t_000:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Yes... I'm sorry to have worried you, Major $$コンロイ$$.」

166:t_000:20.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let what Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$ taught me go to waste.」

166:t_000:21.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Those words... are the finest tribute to the late Lieutenant Colonel.」

166:t_000:22.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Can you hear me, $$バナージ$$?」

166:t_000:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Let me say a little more about what we were discussing earlier.」

166:t_000:25.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Like those who rode a $$ガンダム$$ before you, I'd like to believe that you, too, were chosen by the $$ガンダム$$.」

166:t_000:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「In the end, it was always inevitable. For better or worse. But...」

166:t_000:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The rest is up to you. Don't let the situation crush you.」

166:t_000:31.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Have the courage to drive despair away.)

166:t_000:32.en:
$$ブライト$$
(If you are the $$ガンダム$$'s pilot... a $$ニュータイプ$$, then...)

166:t_001:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「Look, Colonel! $$ギュネイ$$'s here too!」

166:t_001:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$クェス$$...! So you were with $$シャア$$ after all...!」

166:t_001:4.en:
$$メラン$$
「Does $$ネオ・ジオン$$ know that Her Highness $$ミネバ$$ is with us?」

166:t_001:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Most likely. Otherwise, they wouldn't have made their move at this timing.」

166:t_001:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Your Highness. Please withdraw to somewhere safe. The bridge is dangerous.」

166:t_001:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I appreciate your consideration, Captain. ...And that you would spare a thought for me, whose life is targeted by my own comrades.」

166:t_001:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
(This girl... understands her own position...)

166:t_001:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「There's no problem, $$ブライト$$. There is a force here that will protect her.」

166:t_001:12.en:
$$リディ$$
(I will protect her... Even if she never becomes mine...)

166:t_001:14.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As the information said. We've gone and incurred one more debt to $$アマルガム$$...」

166:t_001:15.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Did that lot notice the Psycho Monitor fitted to the Split-Horn and remove it?」

166:t_001:16.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「After the battle at Dakar, the Psycho Monitor went silent, and as a result we could no longer pin down the Box's coordinates...」

166:t_001:17.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Most likely the output of the $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ exceeded our expectations and caused the monitor to malfunction.」

166:t_001:18.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「But if we capture it here, there will be no problem.」

166:t_001:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I will hold $$シャア・アズナブル$$ off. $$アンジェロ$$, $$ギュネイ$$, I'm counting on you to take the $$ユニコーン$$ and the battleship.」

166:t_001:20.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Leader... Leave the man who betrayed $$ジオン$$ to me.」

166:t_001:21.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ギュネイ・ガス$$...! Are you objecting to the Leader's plan?」

166:t_001:22.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Let it be, $$アンジェロ$$. I'm sure $$ギュネイ$$ has some grievances he can't hold back, as well.」

166:t_001:23.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I leave the disposal of $$シャア・アズナブル$$ to you, $$ギュネイ$$. I will command from the rear.」

166:t_001:24.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(Colonel...! Here and now, I'll surpass you!)

166:t_001:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「Stay back, $$クェス$$. $$ギュネイ$$ will be coming for me.」

166:t_001:26.en:
$$クェス$$
「No way! If $$ギュネイ$$'s coming, all the more reason!」

166:t_001:27.en:
$$クェス$$
「But not to fight! I'm going to wake up $$ギュネイ$$, who's clinging to the likes of $$フロンタル$$!」

166:t_001:28.en:
$$シャア$$
「...Understood. I leave $$ギュネイ$$ to you, $$クェス$$.」

166:t_001:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept $$ネオ・ジオン$$! But don't overdo it!」

166:t_001:30.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「$$ダリル$$, $$ワッツ$$! I'm counting on you to guard the $$ラー・カイラム$$!」

166:t_001:32.en:
$$ワッツ$$
「I'm counting on you guys at the front line!」

166:t_001:33.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Hold out somehow until the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ arrives!」

166:t_001:34.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$... It's about time you made your exit from this world.」

166:t_002:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Captain! A ship is charging straight at us!」
